items.question: What is the minimum age for using social media platforms in the UAE under Cabinet Resolution No. 106 of 2026 on children's access to social media?
items.gold: The minimum age for using social media in the UAE is 15 years.
items.fact: UAE minimum social media age set at fifteen years

items.question: Under UAE child digital safety law (Federal Decree-Law No. 26 of 2025), may digital platforms collect personal data of a child under 13 without parental or guardian consent?
items.gold: No, collecting or using personal data of children under 13 is prohibited unless clear consent is obtained from the parent or guardian.
items.fact: Child under 13 data collection requires parental consent
